results.name: 普通查询-月指标组合
results.question: 查询2026年9月的订单量、完单量、完单率
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "订单量", SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "完单量", round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "完单率" FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE ctime >= toUnixTimestamp(toDateTime('2026-09-01 00:00:00')) AND ctime < toUnixTimestamp(toDateTime('2026-10-01 00:00:00'))

understanding.ambiguity: 未指定业务线（代驾/大板等），指标按通用口径理解

results.answer:
2026年9月，订单量为134,211笔，完单量为56,588笔，完单率约为42.16%。也就是说，当月每100笔订单中，大约有42笔最终完成。整体来看，完单率不足一半，订单转化仍有较大提升空间。

注：本次按未指定业务线、采用通用订单口径（订单量按下单总笔数、完单量按已完成订单数）计算。

metrics.detail: 缺指标=[] 实际=['代驾完单量', '大板订单量', '代驾订单量', '完单率', '大板完单率', '完单量', '代驾完单率', '订单量', '大板完单量']

results.name: 多表Join-注册与发单客户
results.question: 查询2025年全年的注册客户数，注册司机数，发单客户数
results.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all WHERE toYear(create_data_time) = 2025) AS "注册客户数", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_driver_all WHERE toYear(create_data_time) = 2025) AS "注册司机数", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer) FROM (SELECT customer_id AS customer FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_large_handcart_order_all WHERE toYear(order_time) = 2025 UNION DISTINCT SELECT customer FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE order_type = 1 AND toYear(toDateTime(ctime)) = 2025 UNION DISTINCT SELECT customer_id AS customer FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_valet_order_all WHERE toYear(order_time) = 2025)) AS "发单客户数"
results.answer:
2025年全年，平台新增注册客户1,032,473人，新增注册司机280,233人；同期共有323,980名客户在当年发过单。整体来看，注册客户规模明显高于注册司机规模，而实际发单客户数约为注册客户数的31.4%，说明当年新注册客户中约有三成左右在年内产生了发单行为。

注：本次按“注册客户/司机以各自表create_data_time所在年份统计、发单客户以大板/小板/代驾三业务线发单客户去重合并统计”的口径计算。

metrics.detail: 缺指标=[] 实际=['注册客户数', '发单客户数', '注册司机数']

results.name: 同比-节前对比
results.question: 查询25号前7天同比去年中秋节前7天发单完单率
results.sql: /* 无法回答：现有表结构不足以计算（缺少"发单完单率"的权威指标定义，且"发单"与"完单"分属不同口径，无法确定分子分母） */ SELECT round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-18' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-10-24' AND status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-18' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-10-24' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS "25号前7天完单率", round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2025-09-29' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2025-10-05' AND status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2025-09-29' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2025-10-05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS "去年中秋节前7天完单率" FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE (toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-18' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-10-24') OR (toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2025-09-29' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2025-10-05')
results.answer:

注：本次按“25号前7天”理解为2026-09-18~2026-09-24、“去年中秋节前7天”理解为2025-09-29~2025-10-05，且“发单完单率”拆解为发单率与完单率、此处仅呈现完单率结果的口径/假设计算。

results.name: 环比-本月对上月
results.question: 查询本月订单量环比上月
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-10-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "本月订单量", SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-09-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "上月订单量", round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-10-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / nullIf(SUM(CASE WHEN toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-09-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0), 4) AS "环比增长率" FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE toDateTime(ctime) >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND toDateTime(ctime) < '2026-11-01 00:00:00'

understanding.ambiguity: 环比对象为2026-09-01~2026-09-30；未指定业务线，默认按整体订单量理解

results.answer:
本月订单量为26758笔，上月为134211笔，环比下降约80.06%（即本月订单量仅为上月的19.94%），订单量出现明显回落。这里的环比增长率0.1994表示本月订单量相当于上月的19.94%，并非增长，而是大幅下降。

注：本次按环比对象为2026-09-01~2026-09-30、未指定业务线默认按整体订单量理解的口径/假设计算。

results.question: 查询2026年9月的GMV、客单价、取消率和接单率
results.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "GMV", round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN total ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS "客单价", round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "取消率", round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_picked = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "接单率" FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE ctime >= toUnixTimestamp(toDateTime('2026-09-01 00:00:00')) AND ctime < toUnixTimestamp(toDateTime('2026-10-01 00:00:00'))
results.answer:
2026年9月，平台已完成订单的GMV为3453.23万元，客单价为610.24元。取消率为57.71%，意味着当月每100笔订单中约有58笔被取消；接单率为72.18%，即每100笔订单中约有72笔被成功接单。整体来看，当月成交规模较大，但取消率偏高、接单率偏低，订单流失情况较为明显。

注：本次按“GMV仅统计已完成订单金额、取消率与接单率均以全部订单为分母、客单价仅以已完成订单计算”的口径计算。

results.name: 复合指标-发单率
results.question: 查询2026年9月的发单率
results.sql: WITH new_users AS (SELECT id AS customer, toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) AS reg_date, ctime AS reg_ctime FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all WHERE toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-10-01'), order_stat AS (SELECT o.customer, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 1) AS has_1d, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 3) AS has_3d, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 7) AS has_7d FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all AS o INNER JOIN new_users AS u ON u.customer = o.customer WHERE toDateTime(o.ctime) >= toDateTime(u.reg_ctime) GROUP BY o.customer) SELECT u.reg_date AS `统计日期`, COUNT(*) AS `新注册用户数`, SUM(os.has_1d) AS `1天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_1d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `1天内发单率`, SUM(os.has_3d) AS `3天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_3d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `3天内发单率`, SUM(os.has_7d) AS `7天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_7d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `7天内发单率` FROM new_users AS u LEFT JOIN order_stat AS os ON os.customer = u.customer GROUP BY u.reg_date ORDER BY u.reg_date
results.answer: 2026年9月新注册客户的首单转化整体在15%上下小幅波动，且随着观察窗口拉长，发单率稳步抬升。以已展示的前8天数据看，1天内发单率在13.7%～16.5%之间，3天内升至14.2%～17.6%，7天内进一步升至14.6%～18.3%，说明注册当天未发单的客户中，仍有相当一部分会在随后几天内完成首单。其中9月5日表现最好，1天、3天、7天发单率分别为16.54%、17.61%、18.25%；9月1日相对偏低，分别为13.71%、14.21%、14.58%。这里的“发单率”指某日注册的客户中，在注册后1天、3天、7天内至少产生一单的人数占当日注册总人数的比例，例如9月1日注册1612人，其中221人在1天内发单，故1天内发单率为13.71%。注：本次按“注册后N日内产生至少一单的注册客户数÷注册客户总数（N=1/3/7），且排除注册前订单”的口径计算。
